title: DETECT Fentanyl and Xylazine Act of 2024
committees: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
last_action: Signed into law as Public Law 118-186.
summary: Authorizes DHS research, testing, evaluation, and cost-benefit analysis for AI- and machine-learning-enabled tools that identify fentanyl, xylazine, controlled-substance analogues, and emerging psychoactive substances, while requiring the work to follow the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
committee_dynamics: This narrowly scoped, bipartisan public-safety measure moved through the homeland-security committees and became a standalone law rather than riding in a larger vehicle.
advance_rationale: Enacted law; implementation replaces advancement forecasting.

responsible_agencies: Department of Homeland Security Science and Technology Directorate
National Institute of Standards and Technology

agency_status.agency: Department of Homeland Security Science and Technology Directorate
agency_status.detail: The statutory research and standards requirements are verified; this audit did not identify a single official public report that resolves implementation across all covered activities.

verification_level: Official public-law text and introduced bill verified.
